chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Ishaq al-Dinuri narrated to us, he said: Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Ziyad al-Nishapuri informed me, he said: Ahmad ibn Mansur al-Maruzi narrated to us, he said: al-Nadr ibn Shumayl narrated to us, he said: Awf ibn Abi Jamila narrated to us, from Abdullah ibn Amr ibn Hind al-Jamali, who said: Ali (peace be upon him) said:
Whenever I would ask the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family), he would answer me; and whenever I was silent, he would begin speaking to me.

key_terms.أعطاني: He gave me / answered me -- referring to the Prophet providing knowledge and answers
key_terms.ابتدأني: He began with me / initiated -- indicating the Prophet would proactively share knowledge without being asked

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about his relationship with Prophet Muhammad in seeking knowledge?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) describes his uniquely close relationship with Prophet Muhammad (SAWW), indicating that the Prophet would proactively share knowledge with him even without being asked. This highlights Ali's special status as the closest disciple and heir of the Prophet's knowledge, a relationship recognized by companions like Abdullah ibn Amr ibn Hind al-Jamali who transmitted this narration.
word_analysis: he would begin speaking to me

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Ishaq al-Dinuri narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. Muhammad b. Ziyad al-Nishapuri informed me. He said: Ahmad b. Mansur al-Maruzi narrated to us. He said: Al-Nadr b. Shumayl narrated to us. He said: `Awf b. Abi Jamila narrated to us from `Abdullah b. `Amr b. Hind al-Jamli.
He said: `Ali (as) said: Whenever I would ask the Messenger of Allah (s), he would answer me; and whenever I was silent, he would begin speaking to me.
